name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
benefit:
1. **Day Scholar**: ₹3500 Per Annum1. **Hosteller:** ₹7000 for Hostellers.
**Additional benefits for  Person with Disability (PwD)** studying in private unaided Schools - 

1. Divyang (Disabled) students are eligible for an additional allowance equal to 10% of the applicable academic allowance.
1. Disability should be certified under the provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should pursue studies in India. 1. The applicant should be studying in a Government school or a recognized private school having a valid UDISE code. 1. The applicant should not hold another educational scholarship for studying in Classes I to X. If awarded another scholarship, the applicant may avail only one scholarship and should inform the concerned authorities about the option chosen. 1. The applicant should maintain satisfactory academic performance and at least 75% attendance in every academic year for continuation of the scholarship. 1. The applicant should be promoted to the next class for automatic renewal of the scholarship. 1. The applicant repeating the same class is not eligible to receive the scholarship for that class for a second or subsequent year.
